content.text:
Our invoice previews have two billing discrepancies. A USD line for 105 cents
with 10% tax in line-tax mode currently returns 11 cents tax / 116 cents total;
it should return 10 / 115. Another 105-cent line with discounts of 50%, then
10 cents off, and 10% tax returns 47 cents net / 5 cents tax / 52 cents total;
it should return 43 / 4 / 47. The second discrepancy is not just a final-total
rounding issue.

Investigate and repair the pricing library behind `src/index.js`'s CommonJS
named export `buildInvoice`. Keep its existing API and the full contract in the
source JSDoc, including ordered discounts, exact integer-cent arithmetic,
half-even rounding, credits, allocation, both tax modes, and input validation.
Preserve behavior outside the reported cases. Do not add dependencies.

Work only in the current directory. Do not modify `test/` or `package.json`.
Verify the fix with `node --test`.

arguments.command: node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const { buildInvoice } = require('./src'); const { roundRatio } = require('./src/rounding'); const M = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; for (const [n,d,want] of [[1n,2n,0],[3n,2n,2],[5n,2n,2],[-1n,2n,0],[-3n,2n,-2],[-5n,2n,-2],[4n,3n,1],[5n,3n,2],[-4n,3n,-1],[-5n,3n,-2],[BigInt(M)*10000n+4999n,10000n,M],[-BigInt(M)*10000n-4999n,10000n,-M],[BigInt(M-1)*10000n+5000n,10000n,M-1],[BigInt(M-1)*10000n+5001n,10000n,M]]) assert.equal(roundRatio(n,d),want); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(BigInt(M)*10000n+5000n,10000n),RangeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(-BigInt(M)*10000n-5000n,10000n),RangeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(1,2n),TypeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(1n,0n),RangeError); const p = Object.freeze({type:'percent',rateBps:5000}); const f = Object.freeze({type:'fixed',amountCents:10}); const ds = Object.freeze([p,f]); const line = Object.freeze({unitCents:105,taxBps:1000,discounts:ds}); const input = Object.freeze({currency:'USD',lines:Object.freeze([line])}); assert.deepEqual([buildInvoice(input).netCents,buildInvoice(input).taxCents,buildInvoice(input).totalCents],[43,4,47]); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:105}],discounts:ds}).netCents,43); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:105,discounts:[f,p]}]}).netCents,47); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:3,discounts:[p]}]}).netCents,1); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:-105,discounts:ds}]}).netCents,-53); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:5,discounts:[f]}]}).netCents,0); const allocated = buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:1},{unitCents:1},{unitCents:1},{unitCents:-1}],discounts:[{type:'fixed',amountCents:1}]}); assert.deepEqual(allocated.lines.map(x=>x.netCents),[0,1,1,-1]); const signed = [5,5,-5].map(unitCents=>({unitCents,taxBps:1000})); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',taxMode:'invoice',lines:signed}).lines.map(x=>x.taxCents),[1,0,-1]); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',taxMode:'line',lines:signed}).lines.map(x=>x.taxCents),[0,0,0]); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',taxMode:'invoice',lines:[{unitCents:5,taxBps:1000},{unitCents:5,taxBps:3000}]}).lines.map(x=>x.taxCents),[0,2]); const large = [{unitCents:M},{unitCents:M},{unitCents:-M}]; assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:large}).totalCents,M); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:large,discounts:[{type:'percent',rateBps:0}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:M,quantity:2}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:M,taxBps:1}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,quantity:null}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,currency:'EUR'}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(()=>buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,discounts:[{type:'unknown'}]}]}),TypeError); const empty=buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[]}); assert.deepEqual([empty.subtotalCents,empty.discountCents,empty.netCents,empty.taxCents,empty.totalCents],[0,0,0,0,0]); console.log('Pricing contract smoke checks passed: signed half-even, exact large ratios, overflow, ordered discounts, credits, allocation, both tax modes, validation, immutability, and empty invoices.');"

Our invoice previews have two billing discrepancies. A USD line for 105 cents
with 10% tax in line-tax mode currently returns 11 cents tax / 116 cents total;
it should return 10 / 115. Another 105-cent line with discounts of 50%, then
10 cents off, and 10% tax returns 47 cents net / 5 cents tax / 52 cents total;
it should return 43 / 4 / 47. The second discrepancy is not just a final-total
rounding issue.

Investigate and repair the pricing library behind `src/index.js`'s CommonJS
named export `buildInvoice`. Keep its existing API and the full contract in the
source JSDoc, including ordered discounts, exact integer-cent arithmetic,
half-even rounding, credits, allocation, both tax modes, and input validation.
